chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not cross the valley of Muhassar until the sun rises.

key_terms.وَادِيَ مُحَسِّرٍ: Valley of Muhassar, a specific valley near Muzdalifa

ai.seo_question: When should a pilgrim cross the valley of Muhassar during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the legal boundary for leaving Muzdalifa, prohibiting passage through the valley of Muhassar before sunrise to ensure the pilgrim has completed the night stay (wuquf) as required. This ruling is central to the Shia jurisprudence of Hajj, distinguishing the precise moment when the pilgrim transitions from the station of Muzdalifa to Mina, thereby fulfilling the pillar of staying until dawn breaks.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not exceed the valley of Muhassar until the emergence of the sun’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must not cross Wadiy Muhassar (valley) until it is sunrise.’” (Fatwa best explains Ahadith 5-6 of this Chapter)
